name: polybromo 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PBRM1 encodes protein polybromo-1. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and chromatin remodeling.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Chordoma; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.

function.text: PBRM1 encodes protein polybromo-1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and chromatin remodeling. Functional annotations also associate the protein with chromatin binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PBRM1 have been reported in chordoma, clear cell renal cell carcinoma, and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
